contradictions.claim: The controller says every manual journal has a different approver, enforced group-wide.
contradictions.evidence: JE-KUK-2608-00055 (KUK, 31 Aug 2026) moves £18,400 from advertising to prepaid expenses. The same person, E3003, created and approved it. Whether it was over their limit needs the employee master, which isn’t in this material.

contradictions.claim: The controller says the Sep 2026 cut-off was clean.
contradictions.evidence: INV-KJP-2609-00363 (¥42.7m net) is dated 30 Sep 2026 but delivered 2 Oct 2026. Revenue belongs to the next month.

contradictions.claim: US credit says Great Lakes Duplicating Supply was within its credit limit until August.
contradictions.evidence: Its balance was over the $600,000 limit in Sep 2025, Nov 2025 and every month from Mar 2026 to Jul 2026. The last payment arrived 21 Jul 2026.

contradictions.claim: AP says the system blocks a duplicate supplier invoice number, in every entity.
contradictions.evidence: KUS entered supplier invoice MFL-58821 twice (API-KUS-2607-00007 and API-KUS-2607-00011), $48,216.40 each, and paid both.

contradictions.claim: The CFO says the group closes in five working days.
contradictions.evidence: Sep 2026 was locked on 8 Oct 2026, business day 6, not 5.

contradictions.claim: FP&A says Europe is on plan in euros.
contradictions.evidence: Kasane Europe’s H1 external sales were €22.55m against a budget of €23.92m (5.7% under). Equipment was 18.2% under. Profit is above plan; sales are not.

gaps.text: No reserve for slow-moving or expired stock, though ink has a shelf life.
No lease inventory yet, and the new lease standard applies from April 2027.
Oct 2026 is open: no month-end entries, data through 15 Oct 2026.
Shanghai’s local account codes are mapped in a spreadsheet nobody has sent.
No 13-week cash forecast inputs: treasury builds it by hand from aging and AP due dates.
Subsidiaries tag product lines differently, so equipment, consumables and service can drift.
Quarterly transfer-price resets are under discussion with no decision recorded.
The forecast has no customer dimension, so the Great Lakes adjustment sits on a whole entity.
